title: About Me
content:
I am a scientist known, for creative and innovative thinking, with a strong attention to detail to efficiently solve problems and meet deadlines. I excel in collaborating with others to achieve shared goals, fostering positive relationships while valuing diverse perspectives and opinions. With strong organizational and planning skills, I effectively set specific objectives, manage resources, and deliver successful outcomes.

My expertise lies in bioinformatics, with proficiency in Python, Bash, R, among other languages and database management using SQL. I am skilled in formulating hypotheses, designing and conducting experiments, and critically analyzing, synthesizing, and summarizing complex data. My problem-solving approach is methodical and focused, enabling me to draw objective, actionable conclusions.
